title: Women's Octopus – Eight Arms, Zero Hugs Embroidered Zip Hoodie
who: the woman with eight arms and no patience for a hug, zipped on for the aquarium trip and the long walk past anyone with open arms.
art: A coral octopus with half-closed, flat-stare eyes sits among rising bubbles with its curled arms and cream suckers tucked in front of it, in coral, teal, navy and cream with a worn print texture.
headline: EIGHT ARMS,
inks: light coral and cream on Black and Navy, brick red and navy on Ash
chest: a small ZERO over HUGS. wordmark in the same heavy slab capitals as the back
warm2: cool aquarium halls, beach evenings and the walk past a hug line
gift_line: for the friend who loves the sea and keeps her personal space.
seo_desc: An octopus zip up hoodie: EIGHT ARMS, ZERO HUGS on the back over a flat-stare coral octopus, plus stitched ZERO HUGS. lettering on the chest.
